notes.title: Bug Fix: Secret Room in Lorena's Puzzle
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that allowed unintended access to the secret room during Lorena's puzzle.
This room should now only be accessible under the correct conditions.

notes.title: BUG FIX AND IMPROVEMENT
notes.content:
- In Lorena's route, when entering the password, you are now asked if you would like to talk or think about
- A bug that did not appear the animation when defeating the anxiety monsters has been fixed

notes.title: BUGFIX
notes.content:
- Fixed some translation errors (English)
- Fixed a bug in the English version where Yuna's image does not appear
at the end 2
- Added a hint for the second easter egg

notes.title: SYSTEM LANGUAGE
notes.content: Added a new option in the menu to change the system language.

notes.title: YEAR UPDATE
notes.content:
Thanks to kindness of you all, i invested more in The game. 
The second, third and fourth endings now have an art that is unlocked by conquering it.
Curious? Get them!

notes.title: IMPROVEMENTS
notes.content:
- The game was better optimized and some unnecessary files were removed
- Added names for the 4 endings
- Added an effect when defeating a NPC
- Added the option to put in fullscreen
- Fixed some language problems in the US version and in the PT-BR version

notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content:
- Fixed some dialog issues in the PT-BR language
- Fixed the bug that appeared a clone of Lorena in the PT-BR language
- Fixed the bug that prevented getting the third ending after getting the second in the PT-BR language
- Fixed the bug at the beginning of the game that made the gameplay difficult in the PT-BR language

notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
I have received a lot of affection from you and besides correcting some translation errors. I decided to create two new endings.

This update has:
- 2 new endings
- More story
- 1 new easter egg
- New songs

Anything bug related, you can contact me on twitter or instagram @Kyonbuteam!

notes.title: Significant changes
notes.content:
Hello, how are you guys? Thanks to some feedback, it was possible to identify and improve the game.
The changes were:

- 2nd ending improvement.
- Story improvements.
- Fixed bug that crashed the game when opening it.
- Fixed some translation errors.
- Fixed the bug that crashed the game in the assertiveness puzzle.
- Change in the arrows puzzle. It was made easier.

To report any bugs, opinions, or feedbacks the page's instagram is @Kyonbuteam
Thank you all for the feedback and support.

notes.title: BUGFIX
notes.content:
Hello people, how are you?

I received reports of the game crashing, but this has been fixed. If the problems persist, try to verify integrity of game files...
